annotations.text:
DIRECTION A — Bold modern

Deep blue + amber, huge Space Grotesk display type, hard edges, big colour blocks. Confident and current; strongest brand recall.

Tradeoff: the loudest of the three — leans marketing over spec-sheet.

Full 9-page site. Clickable: Products filter (15 SKUs), Product-detail tabs. Product ranges and specs are from the supplied Product Catlog PDFs. Contact details (phone / email / address / CIN) are still bracketed placeholders.

DIRECTION B — Industrial technical

Dark UI, Chakra Petch + IBM Plex Mono, visible grid lines, spec-sheet tables and data readouts. Reads like test equipment; signals engineering depth to technical buyers.

Tradeoff: dark + dense is harder to keep readable across a long marketing site; less warm.

Shown: Home + Products (clickable filter).

DIRECTION C — Clean corporate

Light and airy, Manrope headings, rounded cards, soft shadows, photo placeholders, trust-logo row. Calm, safe, broadly approachable B2B.

Tradeoff: the most conventional — easy to execute, but least distinctive.

Shown: Home + Products (clickable filter).

DIRECTION D — the recommended path

Strategy → sitemap → wireframes → identity, done in order. A/B/C jumped to visuals and missed what wins this category: technical credibility, trust architecture (certs, case studies, service network), and buyer-path CTAs for engineers / procurement / urgent.

These 5 wireframes are low-fi on purpose — structure and flow only, no brand colour or final copy. New here vs A/B/C: trust band, Find-your-UPS selector, topology diagram, Service & Support as a top-level section with a coverage map, load calculator, case studies, and an RFQ that captures role + capacity + load schedule.

The Identity board is the visual system to build the hi-fi pass on: 60/30/10 (paper / slate + hairline / signal-blue), orange reserved for the 24×7 line only, IBM Plex Sans + Mono.

Next: build hi-fi Home + Products + Product detail + Service from these.

ADMIN PANEL — matches the live site

Built to the actual deployed site's design system (shivielectronics.github.io), not Direction A–D's exploratory identity: white/soft-lilac "petal" theme, purple→purple-deep gradient accent, pill buttons, 14px card radius, Segoe UI/Inter.

4 static mockups: Login, Dashboard (stats + recent enquiries + quick actions), Products (catalogue table with category filter chips), Enquiries & Leads (Contact / Service Request / Site Survey / Quote / Warranty submissions with status).

Enquiry types mirror the site's real forms. Data shown (names, counts, dates) is sample — not live.
